title: Part of the trip involves...
text: Part of the trip involves very winding roads and can cause some people to get car sick. Our Guide, Luca, was very mindful of this and kept his speed down when we were driving in these locations.
author: Robert_K

title: Pleasant journey with calm Driver and great tour guide Catherine
text: Excellent day Trip, both the driver and guide were amazing. Well explained and did not rushed.
author: ramanjitb2025

title: A perfect day out
text:
A wonderful day. Fully lived up to expectations. Ivan was an excellent guide. Julio an excellent driver.
Ivan paid great attention to the disabilities and limitations of some of the party. In this he was perfect - meeting the needs of all and exceeding expectations.
Can fully recommend this tour without reservation!
author: christD8811NI

title: Lovely easy day trip, comfortable and efficient
text: I came to know of Naturanda through chatgpt recommendations and I booked directly and it was a very well organised day trip to the white villages Zahara, grazalema and Ronda. Very comfortable bus ride, smooth pick up and very enjoyable trip. Our guide was very helpful and was very well informed about the history and geography and natural life of the places we visited. I would definitely recommend Naturanda.
author: Explorer63712739178

title: Fantastic Tour!  Highly Recommend!
text: Fantastic tour!  Luka was a very knowledgeable guide and stopped to show us hidden gems that we would not have been able to appreciate on a large group tour.  Luka took extra time to explain the history of the area and made several pit stops to add even more to our tour.  We both would highly recommend!
author: Anonymous

title: Well worth seeing
text: Excellent trip. Seeing the beautiful white washed villages like Ronda and Zahara was so lovely. Good coach trip and time to look around, have some lunch, go to an olive oil farm and fasting. Thoroughly enjoyed
author: MoyaK_12

title: Fantastic trip to Rona and the white vilkages.
text: Karlos was a very congeial host. He went above and beyond to answer questions and deliver accurate information.  His spoken English was very clear and concise.  We thoroughly enjoyed our trip today.
author: kevinsJ9019IS

title: Excellent full day trip to interesting places! Good value!
text:
Excellent full day tour [10 hours] under a highly competent and charming guide , Martina (Italian). Martina was good communicator, clear and informative. Martina gave excellent tips, e.g., Rondo Hotel with spacious roof patio overlooking Bull ring, dining options,etc). 
Trip was was well paced with interesting stops. Bathroom breaks were in sync with stops. Each stop allowed us to explore or dine as we wished.  Bus was comfortable and had AC.  Highly skilled driver.  Lots of summer road works repairing winter flooding but no long delays!
Only downside was an adult group of six Indian [Goa] men
author: BernardDundalk

title: Beautiful day
text: Beautiful day. Beautiful landscapes.   The guides Antonio and Emilio are excellent.  Antonio tells lots of typical anecdotes about the region.
author: guiraudmyr

title: I recommend
text: The experience was very good. The bus is comfortable and brand new. Attentive staff. The guide, Anita, and the driver, Antônio, were very courteous. We visited a small olive oil farm. The restaurant and other recommendations in the guide were great.
